rv.q: Rajeh is not always an especially elegant mover, but he dances like it's a necessary thing to do.
The work is personal and particular, but the concept of loss is something everyone can connect with and contemplate.
Dance is Not For Us is a short powerful burst of human emotion wrapped in poetic thoughts and a forest of basil plants.

cn.t: Lebanese choreographer Omar Rajeh delivers a powerful, emotionally raw solo exploring loss and displacement, though critics are divided on its execution. The poetic, personal work resonates more strongly with some than others.
